**1B.6 Research Note: Abiy Ahmed in 2024**

**Assessment:** I found no credible 2024 evidence that Abiy Ahmed encouraged nuclear proliferation by allies, proxies, clients, or domestic factions. The closest usable evidence is indirect and points toward the opposite: peaceful nuclear cooperation, regional de-escalation, and a continued DDR/disarmament process. That is still not direct proof of “resisting proliferation,” but it is the best available 2024 record.

| Date | Title | Publisher | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-02-06 | Ethiopia's leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port | Associated Press via CityNews | [https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/](https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/) | Abiy said he had “no intention” of going to war with Somalia and framed peace as mutually beneficial. This is relevant because it shows restraint rather than using any external relationship or coercive leverage to widen conflict. | 1B.6, 1B.2, 1B.4, 1B.1 |
| 2024-02-06 | Canadian Prime Minister Trudeau, Ethiopian counterpart Abiy talk efforts for peace | Anadolu Agency | [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/politics/canadian-prime-minister-trudeau-ethiopian-counterpart-abiy-talk-efforts-for-peace/3129306](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/politics/canadian-prime-minister-trudeau-ethiopian-counterpart-abiy-talk-efforts-for-peace/3129306) | The Canadian PM office said the leaders discussed implementation of the Pretoria Cessation of Hostilities Agreement and stressed continued efforts toward disarmament and demobilization. This is the most direct 2024 evidence of Abiy-backed demobilization rather than weapon diffusion. | 1B.6, 1B.4, 1B.3 |
| 2024-07-01 | Discussion Held with CNNC on Potential Collaboration in Nuclear Energy in Ethiopia | ENA English | [https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4693757](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4693757) | Ethiopian officials discussed peaceful nuclear cooperation with CNNC, including infrastructure development and human-resource training. This supports a civilian, nonproliferation-oriented posture and gives no sign of support for allied or proxy proliferation. | 1B.6, 1B.4, 1B.5 |
| 2024-09-21 | Ethiopia to Chair AFRA for One Year | ENA English | [https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5179100](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5179100) | Ethiopia took over chairmanship of AFRA, an African framework for peaceful nuclear science and technology. This is positive evidence of engagement in peaceful nuclear governance, not proliferation. | 1B.6, 1B.4, 1B.5 |
| 2024-12-12 | Ethiopia-Somalia Ankara Declaration under facilitation of Republic of Türkiye | Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications | [https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/English/haberler/detay/ethiopia-somalia-ankara-declaration-under-facilitation-of-republic-of-turkiye](https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/English/haberler/detay/ethiopia-somalia-ankara-declaration-under-facilitation-of-republic-of-turkiye) | Ethiopia and Somalia agreed to respect sovereignty, set aside disputes, and cooperate. This is the clearest late-2024 de-escalation evidence and is inconsistent with using external partners or clients to sustain destabilizing proliferation. | 1B.6, 1B.4, 1B.1 |

**Search gap**

- I searched directly for 2024 evidence of nuclear proliferation, transfers, proxy arming, allied proliferation, and domestic factions seeking sensitive nuclear capability.
- I found no credible 2024 reporting showing Abiy tolerating or enabling such proliferation.
- I also found no 2024 source showing a concrete attempt by allies, proxies, or domestic factions to proliferate nuclear capability that Abiy had to resist.
- So the record is sparse: the best-supported reading is “no evidence found,” with only indirect pro-restraint signals.

**Bottom line**

- Best available evidence points toward restraint and peaceful nuclear engagement.
- There is not enough direct evidence to say Abiy meaningfully “resisted proliferation” in a strong sense.
- If this lens must be scored, it would have to rely on indirect de-escalation and civilian nuclear-cooperation evidence rather than direct anti-proliferation action.
